blocks.etymology: From Middle English supporten, from Old French supporter, from Latin supportō.

senses.definition: to agree with an idea or person and help them succeed

examples.en: Many local residents support the new proposal.
examples.vi: Nhiều cư dân địa phương ủng hộ đề xuất mới.

examples.en: Which football club do you support?
examples.vi: Bạn ủng hộ câu lạc bộ bóng đá nào?

senses.definition: to provide money, food, or care so someone can live

examples.en: He works hard to support his family.
examples.vi: Anh ấy làm việc chăm chỉ để nuôi gia đình mình.

senses.vi: nuôi nấng; cấp dưỡng; chu cấp

senses.definition: to hold something up so that it does not fall

examples.en: Four stone pillars support the heavy roof.
examples.vi: Bốn cột đá chống đỡ mái nhà nặng.

senses.definition: to provide facts or data that show something is true

examples.en: Recent studies support our initial theory.
examples.vi: Các nghiên cứu gần đây chứng minh cho giả thuyết ban đầu của chúng tôi.

senses.definition: to work with a software feature or help users fix product problems

examples.en: This app supports multiple video file formats.
examples.vi: Ứng dụng này hỗ trợ nhiều định dạng tệp video.

thesaurus.definition: give moral or psychological support, aid, or courage to
support materially or financially
be behind; approve of
be the physical support of; carry the weight of
establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts
adopt as a belief

examples: Don’t move that beam! It supports the whole platform.
He staggered away from the accident site, supported by one friend on each side.
wiktionary.gloss: To help keep from falling.

examples: I support France in the World Cup.
wiktionary.gloss: To back or favor a cause, party, etc., mentally or with concrete aid

examples: Mars does not currently support human habitation.
wiktionary.gloss: To provide sustenance or maintenance for; to sustain in integrity or livelihood.

examples: The government supports the arts in several ways.
wiktionary.gloss: To help, particularly financially; to subsidize.

examples: The testimony is not sufficient to support the charges.
The evidence will not support the statements or allegations.
wiktionary.gloss: To provide evidence for; to lend credibility to.

examples: The IT Department supports the research organization, but not the sales force.
wiktionary.gloss: To serve, as in a customer-oriented position; to give support to.

examples: I support the administrative activities of the executive branch of the organization.
I don't make decisions, but I support those who do.
wiktionary.gloss: To assist or be involved with, but not be responsible for.

examples: Sure they sell the product, but do they support it?
wiktionary.gloss: To answer questions and resolve problems regarding something sold.

examples: Early personal computers did not support voice-recognition hardware or software.
wiktionary.gloss: To be designed to provide capacity for; to work or be compatible with (a part, accessory, file type, program, algorithm, etc.).

examples: to support the character of King Lear
And the award for best supporting actress goes to...
wiktionary.gloss: To play a lesser part in the same production with (a star performer).
